keywords_required: It reduces the demand for fossil fuels, thereby lowering carbon emissions and mitigating climate change.
It extends the lifespan of finite fossil fuel reserves.

questions.question_text: What is one way that individuals can save energy at home? [1]

keywords_required: Turning off lights/appliances, installing insulation, or using energy-efficient LED bulbs.

questions.question_text: Give one positive impact of a secure energy supply. [1]

keywords_required: Economic stability (factories can run without blackouts) or improved standard of living.

questions.question_text: Give two negative environmental impacts of renewable energy sources. [2]

keywords_required: Wind turbines can kill birds/bats and create visual/noise pollution.
HEP dams flood large valleys, destroying habitats and altering river ecosystems.

questions.question_text: Justify the use of non-renewable energy sources. [3]

keywords_required: They provide a reliable, constant baseload of electricity (not dependent on weather/wind/sun).
They are extremely energy-dense, producing massive amounts of power from small amounts of fuel.
The existing global infrastructure (power plants, cars) is already built around them, making it cheaper and easier to continue using them in the short term.
